0.content: Mualani of the People of the Springs is Kachina's first and closest friend. They met when Mualani knocked over Kachina's cake and took her Spiritway-surfing to apologise, on a day Kachina was feeling low after training. Mualani encourages her constantly and worries about her lack of confidence. When Kachina's last teammates quit in 5.0, Mualani handed her own team to Kinich and entered as a pair with Kachina. They won the team stage together, then met in the final one-on-one bout; Mualani refused to go easy, told her to say she wanted it, and lost. Kachina apologised as she landed the final blow. Mualani said she was happy for her, though it was bittersweet.

1.content: Ayo is Kachina's Tepetlisaur companion and "an important member of my family". As a young Saurian he kept running into her at the crossroads to the mines; they greeted each other, swapped small gifts, and one day he simply followed her home. The Children of Echoes treat Saurians as equals, neither livestock nor pets, and Ayo has his own Saurian family nearby. He used to headbutt people as a sign of affection and still sometimes knocks Kachina over. He never wavered when her playmates turned away.

2.content: Uthabiti means toughness and tenacity in the face of adversity. It was given to Kachina by her tribe's Wayob and is carried on a black feather-shaped obsidian stone with a glowing inscription. Bearing a Name obliges her to enter the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame. For years she could not see why the Wayob chose her. She found her predecessors' deeds daunting and felt too weak and tearful to deserve the name. An ancient verse attached to it speaks of standing firm as a mountain and of a body like a roaring blaze that melts down "all that is mean and lowly".

key: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
3.comment: Kachina: The 5.0 Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
3.content: In 5.0 the Pilgrimage had two phases: a team phase collecting Sacred Fire around Natlan, then one-on-one bouts, with five places in the Night Warden Wars at stake. Kachina and Mualani fought through rival teams and even a monster, with Kachina using Turbo Twirly to carry them up a mountain. The night before, the Traveler told her to observe her opponent and fight smarter; she slept well and earned her best score ever. In the bouts she climbed a pillar to beat the flying fighter Liliuo, then defeated Mualani in the final. Mavuika told the victors her order and request was to crush the Abyss.

4.comment: Kachina: Death and rescue from the Night Kingdom
4.content: Kachina fell in the Night Warden War. That team (with Chasca, Iansan and others) won, so the Ode of Resurrection should have brought her back, but Mavuika emerged from the Sacred Flame alone, unable to find her soul or her Ancient Name. Two hecklers mocked her failure until Mavuika shamed them, and the Pilgrimage was suspended. Using Citlali's Spiritspeaker Stone, the rescuers recovered her Name and spoke to her: she had been attacked, hidden by the weakening Wayob, and found that Abyssal corruption was stopping her return. She told them not to risk themselves, then admitted she was scared and wanted to go home.

5.comment: Kachina: Chief Pacal and the Children of Echoes
5.content: The Children of Echoes (Nanatzcayan) live in canyons with the Tepetlisaurs. They mine, value gems, love music and dance, and keep an obsidian totem symbolising their Wayob, which they believe dwells beneath the earth. Chief Pacal treats Kachina's safety as his duty. He demanded the Traveler prove their identity, then urged her to learn from them. He defends her when others talk her down, which makes her feel guilty. He took her to Xilonen to commission Turbo Twirly. He has old injuries that keep him from competing.

6.content: Turbo Twirly is a drill that bores into rock and also hops around. Xilonen forged it at Pacal's request after Kachina received her Ancient Name. On Xilonen's suggestion it has no seat, only manual controls connected to its power core; at Kachina's request part of the shock absorption was removed, because she prefers direct feedback from the ground. She rides it up cliffs, races Ayo on it, and lets it fight on its own. She calls Xilonen's craftsmanship "out of this world" and admires her well-kept gem collection.
